chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Khalid, from Abu Hamzah, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no harm in you prostrating with your garment between your hands and the earth.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to place a garment on the ground during prostration in prayer?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) clarifies the permissibility of using one's garment as a barrier between the hands and the ground during prostration, addressing concerns about ritual purity (taharah) and cleanliness. This ruling reflects the practical jurisprudence of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that minor impurities or dirt on the ground do not invalidate prayer as long as the garment provides a sufficient layer of separation. It underscores the Shia principle of ease in worship, allowing believers to maintain focus on devotion without excessive worry about environmental conditions.
